build.name: compile UART2bus rtl + the tb_uart2bus_top bench
build.cmd: iverilog -Ibench -Irtl -o $BODY/uart.vvp bench/tb_uart2bus_top.v bench/reg_file_model.v $(ls rtl/*.v) 2>&1 | grep -viE 'warning' | tail -6; test -f $BODY/uart.vvp

stdout.text: bench/tb_uart2bus_top.v:146:        : Padding 8 high bits of the port.

runs.name: drive serial frames into the UART->bus controller, watch the register writes/reads
